description_expanded: Dusk til Dune - Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A with Community Pool Favorite Features: - Community Pool - Elevator to All Floors - Golf Cart - Multiple Balconies More about Dusk til Dune: Dusk til Dune is a beautiful four story beach house featuring five bedrooms, two living areas, multiple balconies, and an elevator that reaches all floors for maximum accessibility. Sleeping 21, this home is perfect for large group getaways of all kinds! Located in Dune Allen near Stinky's Fish Camp, a popular local restaurant, and just a two minute bike ride from the beach, Dusk til Dune has everything you need for a memorable vacation! Dusk til Dune brings elegance to the beach with neutral tones accented with shades of blues and teals throughout. Entering on the first floor, guests are welcomed into a cozy living room with plenty of seating on a pull-out sofa gathered around a flat-screen TV. Two bunk rooms on this level will accommodate nine guests across two full/full bunks and a twin daybed and share a full bathroom. Follow the hall towards the back of the house to find a lovely screened-in porch for enjoying a quiet moment with no bugs!  The second floor hosts a spacious open-concept floor plan perfect for entertaining. A gourmet kitchen with a backsplash reminiscent of sea glass, houses stainless steel appliances, a four burner gas stove, sparkling stone countertops, large pantry  and bar seating for four. Next, a formal dining table seating ten leads into the living spaces. Guests have a choice between cozy couches gathered around a TV or a conversation area with four swiveling armchairs - an awesome place to play games. This wonderful main floor living area has access to a balcony with seating for a view of this quaint neighborhood.  Two king bedrooms with a shared bathroom are available on the third floor in addition to the primary king suite. The primary suite is spacious and filled with natural light from the many windows, plus it offers a private balcony overlooking the neighborhood. Attached, the en suite bathroom is also light and bright with a spa-like feel and includes a large rain head shower. Guests will find a gorgeous living space on the fourth floor complete with sleeper sofas gathered around a TV and a convenient wet bar with ice maker and beverage cooler. This floor also features access to an expansive deck with a dining table, outdoor living room, TV, and a 180 degree view of the neighborhood with a peekaboo view of the Gulf, making this an ideal space for entertaining and enjoying warm Florida breezes! If you’re looking for a secluded coastal cottage with fabulous amenities and space for everyone, then Dusk til Dune is the perfect place for your dream beach vacation - Reserve now! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: Full over Full Bunk & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 2: Twin Bed, Full over Full Bunk & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: King Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 5: King Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. FOURTH FLOOR Additional Arrangements: 2 Queen Sleeper Sofas
